40009048.author: पदार्थः
40009048.content: वरायुधधरौ wielders of best of weapons, वीरौ  heroes, महात्मानौ great souls, भ्रातरौ the two brothers, तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा seeing, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, शङ्कितः doubtful, अभूत् became

40009048.author: Translation
40009048.content: On seeing the two great souls, heroic Rama and Lakshmana wielding the best of weapons, Sugriva was alarmed.

40009049.author: पदार्थः
40009049.content: वानरपुङ्गवः best of vanaras, उद्विग्नहृदयः agitated at heart, सर्वाः all, दिशः directions, समवलोकयन् looked at,  कस्मिंचशित् देशे at one place, न व्यतिष्ठत not able to stay

40009049.author: Translation
40009049.content: Agitated at heart, the best of vanaras started in all directions and could not settle down at one spot.

40009050.author: पदार्थः
40009050.content: महाबलौ very strong persons, वीक्षमाणः beholding, स्थातुम् to be steady, मनः to his mind, नैव चक्रे did not, परमभीतस्य much frightened, कपेः monkey's, चित्तम् mind, व्यवससाद  ह sunk

40009050.author: Translation
40009050.content: Beholding the two strong heroes, the monkey (Sugriva) was very much frightened. His heart sank.

40009051.author: पदार्थः
40009051.content: धर्मात्मा righteous, सः सुग्रीवः Sugriva, चिन्तयित्वा reflecting, गुरुलाघवम् relative importance of consequences, विमृश्य analysed, सर्वैः with all, अनुचरैः सह with his followers, परमोद्विग्नः highly agitated

40009051.author: Translation
40009051.content: Righteous Sugriva, became highly agitated, deliberated with all his followers on the pros and cons of the situation.

40009052.author: पदार्थः
40009052.content: ततः then, प्लवगाधिपः lord of monkeys, सः सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ both Rama and Lakshmana, पश्यन् seeing, परमोद्विग्नः extremely terrified, सचिवेभ्यः to his ministers, शशंस said

40009052.author: Translation
40009052.content: Sugriva, lord of monkeys, extremely agitated at the sight of both Rama and Lakshmana, spoke to his minister:

40009053.author: पदार्थः
40009053.content: चीरवसनौ both wearing bark garments, छद्मना in cognito, दुर्गम् to a difficult place, इदं वनम् this forest, प्रचरन्तौ both wandering, एतौ these two, वालिप्रणिहितौ both sent by Vali, इह here, आगतौ have come, ध्रुवम् surely

40009053.author: Translation
40009053.content: Surely these two, clad in bark garments and wandering here in disguise into this difficult forest, have come sent by Vali.

40009054.author: पदार्थः
40009054.content: ततः then, सुग्रीवसचिवाः Sugriva's counsellers, परमधन्विनौ supreme bowmen, दृष्ट्वा seeing, तस्मात् from that, गिरितटात् that mountain, उत्तमम् great, अन्यत् another, शिखरम् mountain peak, जग्मुः went

40009054.author: Translation
40009054.content: On seeing these supreme bowmen, Sugriva's counsellers left for the peak of another mountain.

40009055.author: पदार्थः
40009055.content: अथ then, यूथपाः leaders of troops, ते हरयः those monkeys, क्षिप्रम् quickly, अधिगम्य having reached, यूथपर्षभम् leaders of the group, वानरश्रेष्ठम् best of monkeys, परिवार्य having surrounded, उपतस्थिरे stood

40009055.author: Translation
40009055.content: The leaders of the monkey troops  reached Sugriva, the lord of monkeys, in no time  and stood surrounding him.

40009056.author: पदार्थः
40009056.content: एवम् in that manner, गिरेः from one mountain, गिरिम् to another mountain, प्लवमानाः jumping, वेगेन swiftly, गिरीणाम् of the mountains, शिखराणि अपि tops also, प्रकम्पयन्तः shaking, एकायनगताः one place.

40009056.author: Translation
40009056.content: Jumping  from one mountain to another swiftly and shaking the mountain tops, the monkeys reached one spot.

40009057.author: पदार्थः
40009057.content: ततः then, प्लवमानाः jumping, महाबलाः  extremely strong, सर्वे all, शाखामृगाः monkeys, तत्र there, दुर्गम् संश्रितान् near hilly side, पुष्पितान् fully blossomed, नगान् trees, बभञ्जुः shattered

40009057.author: Translation
40009057.content: Then the mighty monkeys jumping on the trees in full bloom shook them.

40009058.author: पदार्थः
40009058.content: हरिवराः the great monkeys, तम् them, महागिरिम् great mountain, सर्वतः all over, आप्लवन्तः jumping, तदा then, मृगमार्जारशार्दूलान् deer, wild cats and tigers, त्रासयन्तः scaring, ययुः went

40009058.author: Translation
40009058.content: The great monkeys went on leaping all over the great (Rishyamuka) mountain,   scaring the deer, wildcats and tigers.

40009059.author: पदार्थः
40009059.content: ततः thereafter, सर्वे all, सुग्रीवसचिवाः Sugriva's ministers, पर्वतेन्द्रं king of mountains (Rishyamuka), समाहिताः collected together, कपिमुख्येन with the chief of monkeys, सङ्गम्य after assembling, प्राञ्जलयः with folded palms in reverence, स्थिताः stood.

40009059.author: Translation
40009059.content: Thereafter, all the ministers of Sugriva assembled together on the king of mountains and stood (in front of Sugriva), with folded hands.

40009060.author: पदार्थः
40009060.content: ततः then, वाक्यकोविदः eloquent in speech, हनुमान् Hanuman, भयसंविग्नं shaken with fear, वालिकिल्बिषशङ्कितम् suspecting that Vali might have sent, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke

40009060.author: Translation
40009060.content: Suspecting that Vali might have sent them (Rama and Lakshmana), Hanuman, skilful in communication, said to Sugriva who was trembling in fear:

40009061.author: पदार्थः
40009061.content: सर्वैः by all, वालिकृते due to Vali, एषः this, महान् great, सम्भ्रमः agitation, त्यज्यताम् give up, अयम् this, गिरिवरः great mountain, मलयः Malaya, इह here, वालिनः from Vali, भयम् fear, नास्ति not there.

40009061.author: Translation
40009061.content: 'This is a great mountain range of Malaya and there is no fear for Vali here. Give up this fear.

40009062.author: पदार्थः
40009062.content: हरिपुङ्गव O chief of monkeys, त्वम् yourself, यस्मात् due to whom, उद्विग्नचेताः frightened at heart, प्रद्रुतः running, तम् him, क्रूरदर्शनम् cruel figure, क्रूरम् cruel one, वालिनम् Vali, इह here, न पश्यामि, not see

40009062.author: Translation
40009062.content: 'O chief of monkeys I do not see here any sign of the cruel Vali, of whom you are afraid.

40009063.author: पदार्थः
40009063.content: सौम्य O goodnatured, तव your, पापकर्मणः from the sinner, यस्मात् from whom, पूर्वजात् from elder brother, भयम् fear, सः he, दुष्टात्मा evilminded one, वाली Vali, इह here, न not, अहम् I, ते to you, भयम् fear, न पश्यामि  I do not see

40009063.author: Translation
40009063.content: 'O goodnatured Sugriva you are afraid of your elder brother Vali as he is evilminded and sinful. (But) I do not see any reason for you to be frightened as he is not found anywhere here.

40009064.author: पदार्थः
40009064.content: अहो Oh, प्लवङ्गम monkey, यः whoever, लघुचित्ततया  with low intellect, आत्मानम् oneself, मतौ in mind,न स्थापयसि  cannot be steady, ते to you, शाखामृगत्वम् monkeynature, व्यक्तमेव is very clear.

40009064.author: Translation
40009064.content: 'Oh monkey, whoever is lilylivered cannot be steady. It is evident that your very nature as a monkey makes you restless.

40009065.author: पदार्थः
40009065.content: बुद्धिविज्ञानसम्पन्नः one endowed with intelligence and knowledge, इङ्गितैः by gestures, सर्वम् everything, आचर you may do, अबुद्धिम् lack of intellect , गतः  reaches, राजा  king, सर्वभूतानि all beings, न शास्ति हि cannot control

40009065.author: Translation
40009065.content: You who are endowed with intelligence and discernment, act in all things by reading the signs; for a king who loses his judgement cannot govern all beings.

40009066.author: पदार्थः
40009066.content: सुग्रीवस्तु Sugriva also, हनूमतः Hanuman, शुभम् auspicious, सर्वं वाक्यम् all words, श्रुत्वा having heard, ततः then, हनूमन्तम् of Hanumanta, शुभतरम् even more auspicious, वाक्यम्  words,  उवाच ह he spoke

40009066.author: Translation
40009066.content: Having heard the wise words of Hanuman, Sugriva addressed him with words more auspicious.

40009067.author: पदार्थः
40009067.content: दीर्घबाहू longarmed, विशालाक्षौ two largeeyed ones, शरचापासिधारिणौ two wielders of bow, arrows and sword, सुरसुतोपमौ both comparable to gods, एतौ they both, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, कस्य  whose, भयम् fear, न स्यात् will not be created

40009067.author: Translation
40009067.content: 'Who would not be apprehensive of these two longarmed and largeeyed individuals     comparable to sons of gods wielding arrows, bows and swords.

40009068.author: पदार्थः
40009068.content: पुरुषोत्तमौ two excellent men, वालिप्रणिहितौ एतौ have been sent by Vali,  अहम् I, शङ्के  doubt, राजानः kings, बहुमित्राः they have many friends, अत्र here, विश्वासः trust, न क्षमः not proper

40009068.author: Translation
40009068.content: 'I support these two excellent men might have been sent by Vali. Kings have many friends and so it may not be appropriate to trust any king.

40009069.author: पदार्थः
40009069.content: मनुष्येण by a man, छद्मचारिणः spies who move about in disguise, अरयः enemies, विज्ञेयाः    they should be identified, अविश्वस्ताः who do not trust, विश्वस्तानाम् of the trusting men, रन्ध्रेषु when we are not vigilant प्रहरन्ति, हि  will strike

40009069.author: Translation
40009069.content: 'One has to identify these men roaming in disguise. These are not trustworthy and could even be our enemies, making us believe them so as to attack us when we are not vigilant.

40009070.author: पदार्थः
40009070.content: वाली Vali, कृत्येषु in his actions, मेधावी wise, बहुदर्शिनः they have great vision, राजानः kings, परहन्तारः  they kill enemies, भवन्ति will be,  प्राकृतैः by ordinary ones, नरैः by men, ते to you, ज्ञेयाः they should be known

40009070.author: Translation
40009070.content: 'Vali is wise in his actions. Kings employ many strategies to annihilate their enemies. Our gullible individuals should be able to detect them.

40009071.author: पदार्थः
40009071.content: प्लवङ्गम O Monkey, त्वया by you, प्राकृतेनैव by assuming an ordinary form, गत्वा going, तौ the two, इङ्गितानाम् their gestures, प्रकारैश्च by their traits, रूपव्याभाषणेन by  their form and conversation, ज्ञेयौ should be found out

40009071.author: Translation
40009071.content: 'O Hanuman assume an ordinary form and approach them. Try to read them through their gestures, traits, forms and conversations.

40009072.author: पदार्थः
40009072.content: हरिपुङ्गव O best of monkeys, तयोः of both, भावम् intention, लक्षयस्व goal, प्रहृष्टमनसौ if they are pleasing in that ways, प्रशंसाभिः by praising them, इङ्गितैश्च by their signs, पुनः पुनः again and again, विश्वासयन् creating confidence, मम me, अभिमुखमेव favourable way only, स्थित्वा after making sure, धनुर्धरौ the two wielders of bows, अस्य वनस्य in this forest, प्रवेशस्य of entrance, प्रयोजनम् purpose, त्वम् you, पृच्छ  enquire

40009072.author: Translation
40009072.content: 'O best of monkeys ascertain their purpose by praising them and studying their honest intentions. Gain the confidence of the wielders of bows and if you find them agreeable, enquire the purpose of their entering this forest.

40009073.author: पदार्थः
40009073.content: हरिपुङ्गव O best of monkeys, तयोः of both, भावम् intention, लक्षयस्व goal, प्रहृष्टमनसौ if they are pleasing in that ways, प्रशंसाभिः by praising them, इङ्गितैश्च by their signs, पुनः पुनः again and again, विश्वासयन् creating confidence, मम me, अभिमुखमेव favourable way only, स्थित्वा after making sure, धनुर्धरौ the two wielders of bows, अस्य वनस्य in this forest, प्रवेशस्य of entrance, प्रयोजनम् purpose, त्वम् you, पृच्छ  enquire

40009073.author: Translation
40009073.content: 'O best of monkeys ascertain their purpose by praising them and studying their honest intentions. Gain the confidence of the wielders of bows and if you find them agreeable, enquire the purpose of their entering this forest.

40009074.author: पदार्थः
40009074.content: प्लवङ्गम O best of monkey एतौ they both, शुद्धात्मानौ यदि if they are found trust worthy you, जानीहि you may know, तयोः with them, दुष्टाऽदुष्टता evil minded or otherwise, व्याभाषितैः with their talk, वा or, विजेया should be found out

40009074.author: Translation
40009074.content: 'O best of monkeys find out whether they are noble in their intentions or evil in their design through your conversation with them.'

40009075.author: पदार्थः
40009075.content: कपिराजेन by the king of monkeys, इत्येवम् in that manner, सन्दिष्टः having been instructed, मारुतात्मजः son of the windgod, तौ they both, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, यत्र there, गमने to go, बुद्धिम् decision, चकार took

40009075.author: Translation
40009075.content: Instructed thus by the king of the monkeys, Hanuman, son of the Windgod, decided to meet both Rama and Lakshmana.

40009076.author: पदार्थः
40009076.content: महानुभावः highly respected, कपिः monkey, हनुमान् Hanuman, दुरासदस्य not easily conquerable, भीमस्य powerful, तस्य his, वचः words, तथेति so be it, सम्पूज्य offering salutation, अतिबल mighty, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सः राम that Rama, यत्र wherever, तदा then, ययौ went

40009076.author: Translation
40009076.content: Hanuman, the venerable, powerful and not easily conquerable monkey, honoured the words of the great Lord of the monkeys, offered salutations and said 'So be it'. And then proceeded towards the mighty Rama and Lakshmana. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे द्वितीयस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the second sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by the sage Valmiki.
